content: I noticed that docs#CategoryTheory.TransfiniteCompositionOfShape is defined using a SuccOrder and a WellFoundedLT assumption, but none of the theorems in that file depend on either of these assumptions. What's going on? @Joël Riou
This notion is mathematically sound only in that case.
Even if you do want to restrict to well-orders, SuccOrder still seems redundant.
It's just extra data that can always be provided and you're not actually using.

It could be possible to remove the SuccOrder assumption, but in all applications (the structures MorphismProperty.TransfiniteCompositionOfShape and RelativeCellComplex which extend this one), we precisely want to put a condition involving the map from j and Order.succ j, so that this data is always used.
